paite: Huan Sabbath ni abei in han ah Mari Magdalin, Jakob nu Mari leh Salomite ava hoh ua, amah nuh ding in gimlim alei uhi.
heading: Jesu Thohnawnna / (Mat 28.1-8; Luk 24.1-12; Joh 20.1-10)

paite: Ni sagih ani masapen in, zingsangpi in, nisuah lai in han ava tung uhi.
"Han kong a suang kua'n hon khukkhiaksak ding adiam aw?" akichih laitak un,
adak uleh suang khukkhiaksa in amuta uh, alian mahmah ngal a.
Han sung ah alut ua, pasal khat puanngou silh, ataklam pang a tu amu ua; lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Huchi in ama'n akiang uah, "Lamdang sa kei un; Jesu Nazaret mi, akilhden uh, na zong ua; athounawnta; hiai ah a-omta kei; en un, asialna uh!
Himahleh pai unla, anungzuite leh Peter kiang ah, Galili gam ah na ma uah apai ding hi; na kiang ua achih bang ngei in huai ah na mu ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in linna leh lamdang sak luatna in amau atuam ziak in apawt ua, han a kipan atai vengveng ua; alauh ziak un kuamah kiang ah bangmah agen kei uhi.
Huan ni sagih ni masapen zingsang a athohnawn in, Mari Magdalin, asung a pan dawi sagih adelhkhiakna nu kiang ah akilak masapen hi.
heading: Mari Magdalin Kiang A Kilakna / (Mat 28.9-10; Joh 20.11-18)

paite: Amah Jesu ompih zelte kiang ah ava hoh a, misi suun a akah lai un ava hilhta hi.
Himahleh amah ahing a, muh leng amu chih aza na ua, agingta tuan kei uhi.
Huai nung in alak ua mi nih gam lam zuan a apai lai un mel dang pu in akiang uah akilak nawn hi.
heading: Nungzui Nihte Kiang A Kilakna / (Luk 24.13-35)

paite: Amau nungzui dangte kiang ah ava hilh ua, amau thu leng agingta tuan kei uhi.
Huai nung in, an a-um lai un sawm-le-khatte kiang ah akilak a, athohnawn nung a amute thu agintak louh uh leh alungtang khauh thu uah ataihilh hi.
heading: Jesu Sawm-le-khatte Kiang A Kilak / (Mat 28.16-20; Luk 24.36-49; Joh 20.19-23; Nas 1.6-8)

paite: Akiang uah, "Khovel tengteng ah pai unla, thilsiam tengteng kiang ah tanchinhoih hilh un.
Agingta a baptisma tang hotdam in a-om ding a; agingta lou tuh siam louh tang in a-om ding.
Hiai chiamtehnate'n agingtate azui zel ding: Ka min in dawite adelhkhe ding ua, pau thak in apau ding uh;
khut in gulte ala ding ua; sihna gu bangchibang dawn mah le uh bangmah achi kei ding uh; damloute tung ah akhut uh akoih ding ua, adam zel ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Toupa Jesu'n akiang ua thu agen khit in van ah pitouh in a-om a, Pathian taklam ah atu hi.
heading: Jesu Vankahna / (Luk 24.50-53; Nas 1.9-11)

paite: Huchi in amau apaikhia ua, gam teng ah thu agenta uhi. Toupa'n amau aseppih a, chiamtehnate'n zui in thu ahihkip zel hi. Amen.
